return_types_source_derived.apply: numpy.ndarray, mono float32 for the proposed mono float32 inputs; torch.float conversion occurs before the model, and Librosa preserves the input dtype on its resampling return.
return_types_source_derived.get: A zero-dimensional numpy.ndarray (shape ()) with float32 dtype: decoder produces (B,), [0] selects a scalar tensor, then clip/optional round and detach().cpu().numpy(). Values are clipped to [0,1]; round=True returns 0.0 or 1.0.
return_types_source_derived.runtime_measurement_status: These types and shapes are predictions from the exact source and must be checked in the native child, not reported as measured successes.

soundfile_contract.operation: In-memory BytesIO WAV/FLOAT write-read roundtrip at 24000 and 32000 Hz, exact mono shape/rate/float32 sample bytes.

waveform_contract.inputs: Deterministic nonzero finite mono float32 signals of 32000 samples at 32000 Hz and 24000 samples at 24000 Hz; two-second variants are also valid if chosen in advance.
waveform_contract.quality_boundary: Do not set a post-hoc classification threshold to fit observed results. This operation gate does not establish speech quality or robust watermark detection accuracy.
waveform_contract.reason: 32 kHz internal length is divisible by hop_size=320, yielding 101 centered STFT frames for one second, and exceeds the 1024-sample reflection padding. No explicit inverse-STFT length is supplied by the original implementation.
waveform_contract.resampling: At 24 kHz, original apply_watermark calls Librosa resample with default soxr_hq in both directions; get_watermark uses res_type='polyphase', which calls scipy.signal.resample_poly. Exercise both unchanged.
